_note: HAND-WRITTEN by the author as stand-ins for LLM output so the pipeline runs offline. Not model output.

proposals.name: deck_worked_example
proposals.rationale: D->D binds both variables to one value, so (Inheritance $Y $Y) has support 1.

proposals.name: exact_minsup_boundary
proposals.rationale: One pattern has support exactly minsup, another minsup-1; catches >= vs > bugs.

proposals.name: join_gain_three_by_three
proposals.rationale: Three A->B and three B->C links: each clause has support 6 but the join has 9.

proposals.name: join_gain_boundary
proposals.rationale: A conjunction whose joint support equals minsup exactly; catches off-by-one in the conjunction check.

proposals.name: nothing_reaches_minsup
proposals.rationale: Only 4 atoms with minsup 5: the miner must return nothing and not crash.

proposals.name: single_atom_db
proposals.rationale: A one-atom database with minsup 1 stresses the smallest possible search.

proposals.name: one_value_column
proposals.rationale: Every atom has the same second argument, so the constant pattern equals the abstract one.

proposals.name: ternary_links
proposals.rationale: Three-argument links exercise variable sharing across more positions.

proposals.name: mixed_link_types
proposals.rationale: Inheritance and Similarity over the same symbols must not be mixed up by the miner.

proposals.name: nested_atoms
proposals.rationale: Atoms containing sub-expressions; the miner supports only a subset of constructs.

proposals.name: duplicate_atoms
proposals.rationale: Whether duplicate atoms count twice depends on the space; only visible with such data.
